sections.body: A point is written (x, y): go along the x-axis first, then up or down the y-axis. 'Along the corridor, then up the stairs.'
A straight-line graph can be written y = mx + c. m is the GRADIENT (steepness) and c is where the line crosses the y-axis.
In y = 2x + 1, when x = 3, y = 2(3) + 1 = 7. So the point (3, 7) is on the line.

quiz.q: For the point (4, −2), what do you do first?
hints: 'Along the corridor, then up the stairs.'
For (1, 5) you go 1 along, then 5 up.
quiz.explain: Go 4 along the x-axis first, then 2 down.

quiz.q: In y = 3x + 2, where does the line cross the y-axis?
hints: In y = mx + c, which letter is the y-intercept?
quiz.explain: When x = 0, y = 2, so it crosses the y-axis at 2.
